summary.text: Armando Walle is a Democratic state representative who has represented Texas House District 140 since 2009 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Armando Walle worked on the staff of Representative Gene Green, as an intern and liaison to the Hispanic community in the office of Houston City Council Member Carol Mims Galloway, and as assistant to the associate director of the Center for Mexican-American Studies at the University of Houston.

He sits on the board of the Aldine-Greenspoint YMCA, is president of the Ambassadors International Ballet Folklorico, chairs the Harris County Tejano Democrats, and is a member of Saint Charles Borromeo Catholic Church.
Walle took office in the Texas House in 2009.
In the 2023-2024 session he was vice chair of the Licensing & Administrative Procedures Committee and also served on the House Administration and Appropriations committees.
He advanced from the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary; Laura Garcia DeLeon is the Republican candidate in the 2026 general election.
